Native integration mounts actual Loader and PluginPackages with separate installation and profile directories, verifies exact client ownership, no bundle reads/publication on unchanged refresh, and effect disposal.

behavior: Current bare package rows read manifests through the canonical PluginPackages runtime router. Installation-owned Python class mappings no longer redirect their browser resources into an unrelated old workspace package.

Each dirty restart rereads its manifest and export metadata, including prior non-client declarations. Manifest addition/removal, moved client export, external edges and source disable/remove publish the current graph.

Current stat revisions hash Node-style mtimeMs/ctimeMs/size; Windows ctime uses FILE_BASIC_INFO.ChangeTime through the existing Win7-compatible native stat helper. Bundle bytes are not read for unchanged refresh/rebuilt checks.

Graph entry/batch references are relative plugins URLs; absent inject stays absent. Ordered entry revisions generate the combo revision. Host version/optional commit is carried in release without changing the graph revision anchor.
